title: fix: stop gen tests from calling live Tinybird
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Gen tests were timing out at random in unrelated tests (e.g. runs [35845883864](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/35845883864), [35852307496](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/35852307496)) because ordinary requests in the test Worker called production Tinybird:

- Catalog routes (`/models`, `/v1/models`, `/text/models`, …) fetch `model_route_health` on every call since #15157 (676 KB per response).
- Paid-key requests fetch `public_model_stats` for the balance preflight. Test KV is reset per test, so its 1 h cache never hits.
- Production caches both (cf `cacheTtl`, KV); miniflare ignores `cacheTtl`. One local run made 91 such calls: p50 0.4 s, p90 0.9 s, max 31 s.

Changes:

- Adds a gen setup file that answers those two public pipes with `{ data: [] }`, the empty feed the Worker already handles. Tests that assert on these requests still spy on `fetch` first.
- Removes the leftover `vi.resetModules()` in `models-retrieve.test.ts`. Its only consumer went away in #15052, and it forced a ~650 ms Worker re-import before every test.

No assertions or timeouts changed. Registry size is not the cause: with the network stubbed, catalog requests take 0–17 ms on both `main` and `codex/add-mai-image-2-6`.

| Local gen suite | Before | After (2 runs) |
|---|---|---|
| Test time | 130 s, 2 timeouts | 52–54 s, 0 failures |
| `models-retrieve.test.ts` | 21 s | 0.2 s |
| Live Tinybird calls | 91 | 0 |

gist.headline: The test hive stays local
gist.blurb: The gen test suite was occasionally wandering out to production Tinybird for a snack. It now gets the same empty public feeds from a local stub, and the slow re-import ritual has been retired.
gist.summary: Gen Worker tests now stub Tinybird's `model_route_health` and `public_model_stats` public pipes with `{ data: [] }` and remove an obsolete per-test `vi.resetModules()` re-import.
gist.impact: The gen suite avoids 91 live Tinybird calls per run, cutting local test time from about 130 seconds with intermittent timeouts to 52–54 seconds with no failures.

Tiny flowers and code-plants represent the now-stable suite, while a small crossed-out long loading bar hints at the removed module reset.
